select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, tar.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID as assetId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, d.finprod_type as finprodTypeCode, d.PS as psCode, d.PS as ps, d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,
d.ccy as ccyCode, d.ccy as ccy, DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as vDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as mDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate, ftp.TERM_TYPE as termType, ftp.BASIS as basis, ftp.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, d.PRIN_AMT as shareAmt, d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, d.TRADE_AMT as cdAmt, d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatusCode, d.REGIST_ORG registOrg, d.FEE_AMT feeAmt, d.FEE_AMT_PAY feeAmtPay, d.FEE_AMT_UNPAY feeAmtUnpay, IFNULL(jsf.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE,'N') isPayWithTrade, d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL jsf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B08' left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and d.branch=ftp.branch and (ftp.branch_type is null and ftp.branch = '0') left join FIN_DEAL_TARGET tar on tar.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tar.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
